text:
ivy: Quick: opened a PR to add a short migration notice for v1->v2. Two items: param rename model -> model_id and embeddings dim bump. Need brief rollback-safe examples.

sam: Paste the before/after snippets pls.

ivy: v1 example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \\ 
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"Hi\"}'
```

v2 example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \\ 
  -d '{\"model_id\":\"redwood-small-v2\",\"input\":\"Hi\"}'
```

ana: For embeddings add a probe snippet to detect vector length mismatch.

ivy: added probe:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{\"model_id\":\"embed-lite-v2\",\"input\":\"probe\"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

ops-bot: Note created for Dedicated/Private customers: support will schedule reindex window on request. Ticket template TKT-6001.

sam: Add tiny JS/Python shims in samples and a one-line unit assertion.

ivy: Done in PR description. Action items listed: docs review (sam, ana), SDK shim release (sam), ops coordination (ops-bot). Please review PR #5010 today.

ana: LGTM, small wording nit: use "deprecated" and include exact removal date when known.

ivy: Will add timeline before merge. :rocket:
